hints.title: Bucket Chaining Key Partitioning
hints.text: Distribute keys across an array of linked buckets using a modular index projection to resolve collisions gracefully.

hints.title: Collision Bucket Scanning
hints.text: Choose a primary bucket array sized to a large prime (such as 769). On add, check if key exists in bucket; if not, append. On remove, delete key if present.

hints.title: MyHashSet Blueprint
hints.text: In init: buckets = [[] for _ in range(769)]. In add(key): h = key % 769; if key not in buckets[h]: buckets[h].append(key). In remove(key): h = key % 769; if key in buckets[h]: buckets[h].remove(key). In contains(key): return key in buckets[key % 769].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of unique keys inserted
complexity.notes: Modulo hashing with prime bucket count delivers O(1) average time per operation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Boolean array indexing of size 10^6 wastes memory when only few keys are inserted.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Chaining buckets balances memory footprint and collision resolution overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implementation of hashing and collision resolution without standard library hash sets.
